primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: To evaluate the efficacy of LN-145 in participants with recurrent, metastatic, or persistent cervical carcinoma based on the objective response rate (ORR) as assessed by the Investigator per Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST v1.1) for target lesions based on imaging: Complete Response (CR), Disappearance of all target lesions; Partial Response (PR), \>=30% decrease in the sum of the longest diameter of target lesions; Overall Response (OR) = CR + PR.

groups.description: LN-145 monotherapy in participants who have progressed during or following systemic therapy; this cohort is no longer open for enrollment.
